_note: Statistic definitions and formulas, verbatim from Baseball Almanac's Stats 101 pages (offensive, pitching, defensive) plus the abbreviations glossary in abbreviations.json.

stats.name: Adjusted Production
stats.formula: (On Base Percentage / League OBP) + (Slugging Average / League SA) - 1

stats.name: On Base Percentage
stats.formula: (Hits + Walks + Hit By Pitch) / (At Bats + Walks + Hit By Pitch + Sacrifice Flies)

stats.name: Plate Appearances
stats.formula: At Bats + Walks + Hit By Pitch + Sacrifice Hits + Sacrifice Flies + Times Reached on Defensive Interference

stats.name: Runs Created
stats.formula: On Base Percentage x Total Bases

stats.name: Slugging Average
stats.formula: (Singles + 2x Doubles + 3x Triples + 4x Home Runs) / At Bats

stats.name: Stolen Base Runs
stats.formula: (.3 x Stolen Bases) - (.6 x Caught Stealing)

stats.name: Total Base Percentage
stats.formula: (Hits + Walks + Hit By Pitch) / (At Bats + Walks + Hit By Pitch)

stats.name: Adjusted Pitching Runs
stats.note: Runs prevented versus a league-average pitcher in a neutral park.

stats.name: Earned Run Average
stats.note: The oldest pitching statistic — earned runs allowed per nine innings.

stats.name: Game Score
stats.formula: Start with 50 points; add 1 point per out recorded (3 per inning), with bonuses and penalties for strikeouts, hits, runs and walks.

stats.name: Opposing Team's Batting Average
stats.formula: Hits Allowed / (Batters Faced - Walks - Hit Batsmen - Sacrifice Hits)

stats.name: Walks And Hits per Inning Pitched

definitions.name: Hold
definitions.definition: Credited to a relief pitcher who enters with a lead, records at least one out, preserves the lead, and hands it to another pitcher.

definitions.name: Save
definitions.definition: Credited to a relief pitcher who finishes a won game without earning the win, provided he meets the qualifying criteria.

stats.name: Defensive Average
stats.formula: The rate at which fielders turn balls hit into their zone into outs.

stats.name: Fielding Runs
stats.formula: Weights putouts, assists and double plays, then compares the total to positional norms, expressed in runs.

stats.name: Range Factor
stats.note: Plays made per nine innings at a position.

stats.name: Zone Rating
stats.formula: Share of balls hit into a fielder's zone of responsibility that he converts into outs; double plays count as two outs.
